title: Modifier names
source: hoi3-reversing: ghidra/project.json struct CModifierValues - 143 entries, read live (CLASSES.md, Modifiers): ids 0-107 from InitModifierDefinitions (0x56E00), 108-139 from InitMissionEfficiencyModifiers (0x183810), 140-142 suseptibility_<faction tag> (FINDINGS-politics.md section 1). A modifier is keyed in script by the definition's save token (CModifierDefinition +0x20), not its name (+4, a localisation key such as MODIFIER_GLOBAL_IC); the token of 0-107 is the field name lower-cased, each one a key of ghidra/saveTokens.json, with casualty_trickleback (TRICKLEBACK) and partisan_efficiency (PARTISAN_EFFICENCY) the two exceptions, and entry 105 (a second NAVAL_INTEL_BOOST) left out because its token is not established. The mission efficiencies are keyed by the order's token, the definition's name less `_eff`. CModifier::LoadKey (0x59620) names one key of its own, `icon`. Claims no file: other schemas include its block `modifier_names:modifiers` wherever a block is `name = number` modifiers.
